notes: WArmy 0.4.1: fixes for default model selection drift, authorization card auto-scroll interruption, chat status marker layering, queue priority promotion with unified tiers, and text editor shortcuts; the in-app text editor now closes with its own hotkey; factory prompt drafts ship in all 27 languages and follow the UI language until you edit them; language tiles use flexible layout with explicit Norwegian (Bokmal) naming. Adds a self-healing layer for model calls: error classification with backoff retry, a circuit breaker, and loop/stall detection, plus clearer retry notices. Hardens context-length error detection and makes retry backoff monotonic.
